top_level_help.stdout:
usage: exl3-mlx [-h] {inspect,validate-linear,fetch-linear,train-smoke} ...

Small, reproducible primitives and checkpoint inspection commands.

positional arguments:
  {inspect,validate-linear,fetch-linear,train-smoke}
    inspect             Read local checkpoint headers; does not load a model
    validate-linear     Compare one matrix's decode/forward/dX to NumPy
    fetch-linear        Download one matrix with bounded HTTP ranges
    train-smoke         Fit a synthetic residual; not full-model SFT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Full workflow: prepare, train, evaluate, generate, doctor (COMMAND --help)

train_help.stdout:
usage: exl3-mlx train [-h] --model MODEL [--memory-gib MEMORY_GIB]
                      [--allocator-cache-mib ALLOCATOR_CACHE_MIB]
                      [--reserve-gib RESERVE_GIB] [--cache-mib CACHE_MIB]
                      [--chunk-size CHUNK_SIZE] [--verbose] [--config CONFIG]
                      --data DATA [--valid-data VALID_DATA] --output OUTPUT
                      [--steps STEPS] [--seq-length SEQ_LENGTH] [--rank RANK]
                      [--alpha ALPHA] [--learning-rate LEARNING_RATE]
                      [--grad-accumulation GRAD_ACCUMULATION]
                      [--clip-grad CLIP_GRAD]
                      [--adapter-layers [ADAPTER_LAYERS ...]]
                      [--expert-adapter-layers [EXPERT_ADAPTER_LAYERS ...]]
                      [--no-checkpoint] [--truncate] [--seed SEED]
                      [--resume RESUME | --resume-adapter RESUME_ADAPTER]
                      [--save-every SAVE_EVERY] [--keep-last KEEP_LAST]
                      [--eval-every EVAL_EVERY]
                      [--eval-examples EVAL_EXAMPLES] [--verify-reload]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL
  --memory-gib MEMORY_GIB
  --allocator-cache-mib ALLOCATOR_CACHE_MIB
  --reserve-gib RESERVE_GIB
  --cache-mib CACHE_MIB
  --chunk-size CHUNK_SIZE
  --verbose             Log every layer
  --config CONFIG       JSON defaults; explicit CLI flags override
  --data DATA           Training JSONL or prepared dataset directory
  --valid-data VALID_DATA
                        Optional validation JSONL; auto-detected in data
                        directory
  --output OUTPUT       New run directory
  --steps STEPS         Additional optimizer steps
  --seq-length SEQ_LENGTH
  --rank RANK
  --alpha ALPHA
  --learning-rate LEARNING_RATE
  --grad-accumulation GRAD_ACCUMULATION
  --clip-grad CLIP_GRAD
  --adapter-layers [ADAPTER_LAYERS ...]
  --expert-adapter-layers [EXPERT_ADAPTER_LAYERS ...]
  --no-checkpoint
  --truncate
  --seed SEED
  --resume RESUME       Restore adapters, Adam moments, RNG and sample cursor
  --resume-adapter RESUME_ADAPTER
                        Warm start weights with a fresh optimizer
  --save-every SAVE_EVERY
  --keep-last KEEP_LAST
                        Retain this many checkpoints in this run
  --eval-every EVAL_EVERY
  --eval-examples EVAL_EXAMPLES
  --verify-reload       Check post-training prediction reload
